name: pm-vcs
description: A general version control system written from scratch on the pm SDK for arbitrary files and structured records, with stable file and change identities, native PM attribution, its own object store, refs, merge, operation log and bundles, and no Git dependency.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test test/*.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run duplicates
scripts.audit:prod: node --input-type=module -e "import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'; import { devNull } from 'node:os'; const env = { ...process.env, npm_config_userconfig: devNull, NPM_CONFIG_USERCONFIG: devNull }; for (const key of Object.keys(env)) if (key.toLowerCase() === 'npm_config_allow_scripts') delete env[key]; const win = process.platform === 'win32'; const r = spawnSync(win ? 'npm.cmd' : 'npm', ['audit', '--omit=dev', '--ignore-scripts'], { stdio: 'inherit', env, shell: win }); process.exit(r.status ?? 1);"
scripts.release:check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run lint && npm run duplicates && npm run docstring && npm run coverage && npm run accept:native-toon && npm run accept:stat-cache && npm run accept:self-host && npm run audit:prod && npm run audit:identities && npm run pack:dry-run && npm run changelog:check && npm run verify:release-changelog-date && npm run verify:release-publish-attestation
scripts.coverage: npm run build && npm run build:test && c8 --all --100 --reporter=text --reporter=lcov --include='*.ts' --include='engine/**/*.ts' --include='scripts/**/*.ts' --exclude='test/**' node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.ts

author: @unbraind

catalog.summary: A from-scratch version control system for structured project data. Own object store, refs, diff, merge, operation log and bundles - no git underneath. Records merge per field, so two agents editing two different fields of one item always converge.
